commit_message.description: Subject line, blank line, body. Empty when you changed no file.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what you changed and what you left.

items.description: One entry per feedback ref, every ref exactly once.

ref.description: The ref from the feedback file, copied exactly.

disposition.description: fixed: the code on the branch now addresses it, through your change or an earlier commit. refuted: the claim is wrong or not worth acting on. deferred: a product decision for the PR author.

reply.description: refuted: one short, casual, concrete sentence that says why (for a ci ref: why the PR did not cause the failure). fixed and deferred: empty.
